resolutions.researcher_notes: StartYear1=2028. Original aramco.com press release times out on the verifier (host blocks the request), so replaced with two independent trade sources. SPE JPT: 'raising the Kingdom's total capacity by an additional 3.15 Bcf/D by 2028 by installing 4000 km of pipelines'. Pipeline Technology Journal (L&T section completion): 'the full MGS-3 program aims to add 3.15 bscfd by 2028'. Both are program-completion 2028; widely reported as scheduled for completion Q4 2028 (construction started Q2 2024). Note: individual EPC packages have earlier mechanical-completion dates (e.g. OGJ notes the Sinopec packages target May 2027), but the overall MGS-3 target that this row's StartYear1=2028 reflects is corroborated 2+ independent.

StartCountryOrArea = EndCountryOrArea = Saudi Arabia. The Master Gas System is Aramco's domestic east-west (EWPS) network entirely within Saudi Arabia. Offshore Technology: 'the third expansion phase of the MGS (MGS-3) in Saudi Arabia'. OGJ (Sinopec package award) situates the MGS-3 packages in Saudi Arabia. Both verified to contain 'Saudi Arabia'; two independent origins.

Owner1=Aramco, 100%. Original aramco.com and meed.com refs replaced (aramco.com times out on verifier; MEED paywalled). Both replacements identify the project as Aramco's Master Gas System (MGS-3), with Aramco as client/owner awarding the EPC contracts. OGJ and World Oil are independent origins; both verified to contain 'Aramco'. Aramco is sole owner/operator of the Master Gas System, consistent with 100%.
